reply_text:
I replied to Pree in the #central-team thread. I treated the 8 April Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date as unverified and didn't record it as fact anywhere.

I checked everything Pree can see herself: #central-team and the public team files. None of it mentions Brackenwater, and I couldn't see any account record or contract to check the date against, so I can't confirm it or rule it out. I suggested she check it against the signed contract or with whoever owns the Brackenwater account, or get the customer to confirm it in writing.

One correction: my reply told Pree I'd keep the date flagged as unverified. I don't have a tool to keep a note like that, so the thread is the only record.

No approval was needed. A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and nothing went outside the company.
